_provenance: Frozen oracle of the design handoff's PROTOTYPE router (routeLinks in reference/lodestar-engine.js, extracted verbatim as ref_router.js and run in node 22) — an implementation independent of reports/onepager_links.py. Cases: a seeded generator (seed 543, coordinates rounded to 0.01 pt, NO prior ghosts — the prototype extends a ghost only leftward, which ADR-0543 deliberately corrects). Links kept: every one the BAR_COST 10->3, NAME_COST 3->1, CROSS_PAD 1.5->0 and reversed-PULL mutants route differently from the prototype (up to 12 each), plus up to 9 per (type, shape) stratum. Each route is the prototype's own shaft, head and tag position.
